'''1998 Decipher World Championship Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Virginia Beach, Virginia on 22 November 1998. It is known from Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d110">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ day-one-world-championships], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 16 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-16-day-one-world-championshipsd110/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 22 November 1998
* '''Site:''' Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Winner:''' 
* '''Format:''' sealed deck (product not stated; the Official Tournament Sealed Deck ([[Enhanced Format Sealed Deck]]) had been released in May 1998, and Enhanced Premiere packs in November 1998)<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Players Committee (Official Tournament Sealed Deck "Released: May 1998", p. 30; Enhanced Premiere "Released: November 1998", p. 22; Enhanced Cloud City "Released: December 1999", p. 23). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="tr-d110" />
